name: 邮件草稿
description: 官方插件:邮件草稿管理面板 + agent 工具(mail_create_draft / mail_list_drafts)。这一版不会真的发信——没有 SMTP,也没有投递接口

tools.name: mail_create_draft
tools.description: Create an email draft (to / subject / body). The draft appears in the mail panel for the user to review and send. Use whenever the user asks to write or reply to an email.

tools.name: mail_list_drafts
tools.description: List all email drafts with their status.

tools.name: mail_send_draft
tools.description: Mark an existing draft as sent. NOTHING IS ACTUALLY DELIVERED — this revision has no SMTP and no delivery API; it flags the draft and shows a desktop notification. Say so if the user expects the mail to arrive.

subject.description: Subject of the draft to send (exact or prefix match)
